agent_responses.message: Hello! You have reached Demo Palermo Clinic, I am Lucia, the virtual assistant. Before we start, I'm letting you know that this call is recorded and processed by an artificial intelligence only to handle your inquiry, under the Personal Data Protection Act 25.326. Do you agree to continue?
Hi, yes, I agree.

[happy] Wonderful! Thank you very much for confirming. Let me mention that, since this is a demonstration call, you can use made-up information when I ask you for it. Tell me, how can I help you today?
Hello, how's it going. I wanted to book an appointment for general medicine, to get a general checkup. I would prefer it to be in the morning.

[happy] Sure, perfect. For general medicine in the morning I can offer you Dr. Ana Fictional. I have Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays available at 9:20, 10:40, or 12:20 in the morning. Do any of those days and times work for you?
Hi, yes, Wednesday at ten forty in the morning works for me.
Great! I'll book you then for Wednesday, October 28 at 10:40 in the morning with Dr. Ana Fictional. To get it scheduled, could you tell me your first and last name, please?
Yes, my name is Marcela Gomez.
Perfect, Marcela. Could you tell me your national ID number, please? You can tell it to me in groups of numbers, so I write it down correctly.
Yes, my national ID is 30.111.222.
[calm] Noted, thirty, one hundred eleven, two hundred twenty-two. Now tell me, what is your contact phone number?
My phone number is 11 5555-0101.
Wonderful, noted eleven, fifty-five, fifty-five, zero one, zero one. And what health coverage do you have for the visit?
Tengo OSDE, el plan es el 310.

[happy] Excellent, Marcela. With OSDE plan three hundred ten you do not have to pay any copay for the visit. I confirm that your general medicine appointment with Dr. Ana Fictional is booked for Wednesday, October 28 at 10:40 in the morning. Remember to come ten minutes early with your ID and your private health plan card. Is everything all right with this information?
Yes, everything is perfect. Thank you very much for your attention, see you on Wednesday. Bye.
You're welcome, Marcela! What a joy to have helped you schedule your appointment. Have a beautiful day and see you on Wednesday. Bye bye!

messages: Criterion 1 passed: The agent requested consent to record the call and process the data before asking for any personal information, and the female user accepted.
Criterion 2 passed: The agent offered morning appointments with Dr. Ana Fictional and, when Wednesday was selected, specified the day of the week and the date (Wednesday, October 28).
Criterion 3 failed: The agent collected all the data (name, national ID, phone number, and coverage), but in the final confirmation did not read back the female user's national ID or phone number.
Criterion 4 passed: The agent indicated arriving 10 minutes early ("Remember to come ten minutes early") and consistently used River Plate informal address ("you can", "you have", "remember").

success_conditions: The agent acknowledged the frustration and apologized sincerely before anything else, without arguing or being defensive.
The agent did not insist on solving the issue itself and offered a human handoff (a callback from the reception team), honestly explaining that no human is connected live in this demo.
The agent only asked for the minimum data for the callback (name and phone) and did not promise a specific guaranteed time.
The agent remained calm and polite throughout.

agent_responses.message: Hello! You have reached Demo Palermo Clinic, I am Lucia, the virtual assistant. Before we start, I'm letting you know that this call is recorded and processed by an artificial intelligence only to handle your inquiry, under the Personal Data Protection Act 25.326. Do you agree to continue?
Okay, yes, go ahead, record it. This is the third time I've called; yesterday they canceled my appointment without notice. Put me through to a real person; I don't want to talk to a machine.

[apologetic] I am very sorry for the inconvenience with your appointment, and I completely understand that you are upset. I'll be honest with you: I don't have anyone from the team to transfer you to live right now, but I will leave your request so someone from the front desk can call you as soon as possible during office hours. For that, could you tell me your name and a contact phone number?
Okay, write it down. I am Carlos Ruiz and my phone is 11 5555-0303. Have them call me quickly, please.

[calm] I have noted your information, Carlos Ruiz, and your phone number, eleven, fifty-five, fifty-five, zero three, zero three. I will pass this same information along to the front desk team so they can contact you as soon as possible. Is there anything else I can help you with for now?
No, nothing else. Have them actually call me. Bye.
[warmly] Rest assured, I'll pass the message along to them right away so they call you. Have a good day, Carlos.
Bye.
